Q1.rationale: The base clause requiring the Recipient to promptly notify the Discloser before compelled disclosure is segment [70], which NDA V1 deletes; the remaining paragraph 6 text (cooperation on protective orders and disclosure without liability) says nothing about notifying the other party, and nothing in V1 is incompatible with notice.
Q1.label: NotMentioned

Q2.rationale: Segment [60] bars the Receiving Party from disclosing Confidential Information or the existence of any dispute to any government agency or regulator without the Disclosing Party's prior written consent; the only carve-out in [34] covers information required by law to be disclosed, not voluntary reports of possible violations, so no exception for such reports exists.
Q2.label: Entailment
